[[Saltspray Beach (Luxon)|Saltspray Beach]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance battle]]s from the [[Luxon]] side. It has the same appearance as the Luxon base in battle. 

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Luxon Navigator]] at a Luxon [[guild hall]] when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is between [[Kurzick]] and Luxon territory.
